title: CS daily scratchpad - QBR prep & renewals
body:
Quick notes for today (11 Mar 2026) - morning scratchpad:

PRIORITIES:
- QBR prep: Acme Corp (Thu 3/12) - finalize deck + ask list
- Renewal check-ins: BetaHealth (renewal 4/01) + OrbitAnalytics (renewal 3/18)
- Support follow-ups: ticket #CS-987 (latency regression), #CS-1023 (audit logs missing)

ACME CORP QBR (Thu 3/12, 11:00 PT)
- Objectives: show adoption metrics, performance improvements from Dedicated plan, propose 12-mo reserved capacity discount
- Slides to finalize: 2 (Usage trends), 5 (Latency improvements), 8 (Cost breakdown) — ask engineering for updated per-route latency numbers (Alex)
- Talking points:
  - "We saw 2.1x throughput improvement after switching to continuous batching"
  - "Recommend Dedicated Reserved for predictable SLAs; estimate 18% lower unit cost at current load"
- Ask list:
  - Latest P99 latencies by model & route (Alex)
  - Any open incidents in last 90d (SRE)
  - Compliance summary for audit (Priya)
- Action: share draft deck with stakeholders by EOD Wed (me)

RENEWALS
- BetaHealth (renewal 2026-04-01)
  - Account health: good, but finance wants line-item cost breakdown
  - Risk: procurement delays + SOC2 attestation copy needed
  - Next step: send renewal estimate + SOC2 cert copy by Fri 3/13 (Priya)
- OrbitAnalytics (renewal 2026-03-18)
  - On trial for Dedicated; currently using burst pool. Need to confirm expected steady-state qps for sizing
  - Action: schedule sizing call and propose 3 options (monthly, 6-mo commit, annual) — target Mon 3/15 (me)

SUPPORT FOLLOW-UPS / OPEN TICKETS
- CS-987 latency regression (reported 3/08)
  - Notes: customer sees P95 increase after recent model variant change. Engineering digging into kernel path selection.
  - Temp workaround: route critical traffic to previous variant (rollback) — need approval from platform (Alex)
  - My note: push for rollback if no fix by EOD 3/11 to avoid churn
- CS-1023 missing audit logs (reported 3/09)
  - Root cause likely config mismatch for on-prem agent. Customer provided logs; ticket assigned to Private Deployments team (Priya)
  - Action: confirm ETA and send interim status email to customer by 3/12 (me)

MEETING LOG / TODO (today)
- 09:00 sync w/ Alex (engineers) — ask for latency numbers + rollback plan (done?)
- 10:30 renewal review w/ finance (prep: cost breakdown for BetaHealth)
- 14:00 prep session: Acme deck dry-run (invite: Alex, Priya, Solutions)
- 16:00 Outreach: OrbitAnalytics sizing invite + proposed dates

QUICK REMINDERS / SCRIPT LINES
- If asked about pricing: highlight unit cost reductions from batching + quantization profiles; offer proof-of-concept Dedicated sizing numbers
- For compliance questions: SOC2 + KMS/HSM options available in Private deployment; can supply redacted logs for auditors on request

NOTES TO SELF
- Draft email templates for renewal outreach (short + CFO-friendly) — keep 3 variants (1- annual, 2- 6mo, 3- month-to-month)
- Save snippet: "Recommend Dedicated Reserved for predictable SLAs; pricing examples attached"
- Follow-up: check Acme feature usage for new embedding route (may justify higher tier)

MISC / LINKS
- Acme usage dashboard: (link) — paste before sending deck
- Deck template: CONFLUENCE:CS/QBR-template
- Recent latency graphs: /shared_drives/engineering/observability/acme-latency-2026-03.pdf

END OF SCRATCHPAD - quick update will move items to main playbook after QBR
